# Codes

This page collects research codes related to my projects in numerical linear algebra, matrix equations, and randomized algorithms.

---

## Projection methods with a probabilistic component for linear matrix equations

MATLAB codes developed during my Master's thesis project on projection methods, Krylov methods, and randomized sketching techniques for large-scale matrix equations arising from PDE discretizations.

### Topics

- Krylov subspace methods
- Truncated Krylov methods
- Randomized sketching
- Matrix equations
- Sylvester-type equations
- Large-scale numerical linear algebra
- MATLAB implementations

### Repository

[GitHub Repository](https://github.com/eugeniot56/sketched-krylov-matrix-equation.git)
